description: Save a business's legal name, entity type, industry, website, address, authorized contact and what it will text (service only, or service and sales) for its own carrier registration. Business owner only. Each field holds an answer from the owner; anything omitted is filled from what is already on file (see get_text_registration `known`). Answers can be saved one at a time: answers given so far are kept, and while questions remain the result lists `saved_steps`, `missing` and `next_question`. The owner can finish here or on the registration page. Never takes the EIN: the owner types it on the registration page returned as setup_url. Each saved answer replaces the value on file for that field. Refused once a filing is already with the carriers. Charges nothing and files nothing.

contact_phone.description: A US number the carriers can reach.

contact_title.description: As the contact signs, e.g. Owner.

legal_business_name.description: Exactly as on the IRS EIN letter.

street.description: Must match the address the IRS has.

text_types.description: service: replies and follow-ups to people who contacted the business. service_and_sales: also lets sales texts go to people who opted in to marketing.

name: save_text_registration_details
title: Save Text Registration Details
